title: India’s Central Bank to Drain 1 Trillion Rupees Via Bond Sales
text: India to Drain $10.5 Billion From Banks After Cash Buildup India’s central bank will drain 1 trillion rupees ($10.5 billion) from lenders through bond sales, its strongest effort yet to tackle a massive build-up of surplus cash in the banking system that poses inflationary risks. content_html:
India to Drain $10.5 Billion From Banks After Cash Buildup

India’s central bank will drain 1 trillion rupees ($10.5 billion) from lenders through bond sales, its strongest effort yet to tackle a massive build-up of surplus cash in the banking system that poses inflationary risks.

Analysts said the announcement of extra bond supply is likely to push up sovereign yields when markets reopen on Tuesday, after they climbed mirroring global trends on Friday. Indian bond and currency markets are shut on Monday for a public holiday.
